issues.title: Noisy CA mask selection boundary
issues.description: 180/288 (62.5%) of (layer, KV-head) pairs had CA score gap < 0.005 between the 8th and 9th ranked RoPE pairs. With only 4 calibration sequences x 4096 tokens x 256 sampled positions, the top-8 selection was unreliable (~20% of selections were noisy). Fixed by running CA profiling with 16 sequences x 8192 tokens x 512 sample positions (4x more data), producing v2 masks with 80.6% overlap with v1.

issues.title: Value cache not benefiting from channel boosting
issues.description: Both Kitty and FCBoost v1 only applied mixed-precision boosting (INT2->INT4) to key cache channels. Value cache was always quantized to flat INT2 without any channel boosting. Implemented value cache boosting in FCBoostKVCache that applies the same static CA-derived promote_mask to value cache quantization in both prefill and decode paths. This required handling non-divisible token counts by processing in group_size chunks with remainder handling.

summary: FCBoost v2 with improved CA masks (4x more calibration data) and value cache boosting achieves 71.11% average accuracy on AIME24+AIME25, a +5.00pp improvement over FCBoost v1 (66.11%) and +4.44pp over Kitty (66.67%). AIME24 improved dramatically from 65.56% to 74.44% (+8.88pp). AIME25 improved modestly from 66.67% to 67.78% (+1.11pp). All three seeds show consistent improvement.
